texts: Hesper is the Cauldron Hall Warden.
Hesper became Warden two years ago.
Hesper does not sit on the Council.
Hesper reports essence production to the Council at each full moon.

fields.sentence: Hesper is the Cauldron Hall Warden.

q2_gaps: title-cased office phrase whose premodifier is itself a proper noun ("the Cauldron Hall Warden") — the mechanical name cue ("the name is exactly its capitalized run of words") would make the whole run one name, while the proper-noun-premodifying-a-common-noun-head rule (whose examples all have a lowercase head: "a Northgate spokesman") splits it into named entity + common-noun head; the instruction set does not say which wins when the head noun is capitalized too
definite predicate nominal / office equative ("X is THE N") — there is no carrier for the uniqueness the definite article states, so it is encoded exactly like the indefinite "X is a N"
review.notes: Under the reading that "Cauldron Hall" is the name and "Warden" the head noun, the parse follows the Northgate-spokesman pattern exactly — head-noun typing predicated of Hesper, the opaque (Possession hesper cauldron_hall) in possessed-first order, and the kind word inside the name licensing (Member cauldron_hall hall).

fields.sentence: Hesper became Warden two years ago.

review.notes: Matches the change-of-kind resultative shape exactly (subject as Patient of the become event, same-subject reified state, unwrapped flat copular atom, Result link) and the 'N units ago' anchor (BeforeBy ... now 2 year). 'Warden' correctly stays a lowercase common-noun class with no Name atom, per the capitalized-common-noun default.

fields.sentence: Hesper does not sit on the Council.
parse: (: t5_no_sit (And (Member sk_sit_1 sit) (Experiencer sk_sit_1 hesper) (On sk_sit_1 sk_council_1)) (STV 0.0 0.99))

q2_gaps: A POSTURAL verb in a non-spatial (membership) sense — "sit on the Council": the "Where a THING is" rule says a bare position clause mints NO event whatever its verb and puts the non-containment preposition entity-attached ((On hesper sk_council_1)), while the prepositional-verb rule reifies the verb as an event and puts the NP in the preposition's oblique ((On sk_sit_1 sk_council_1)); the instruction set gives no precedence, and the two yield different negation bundles.
review.notes: Negation shape is correct: one strength-0.0 (And ...) over the event class and role atoms, with the presupposed definite "the Council" typed at top level and the Name atom projected out, and no Name for a capitalized common-noun-only label. Experiencer is the right subject role for a stative intransitive under the given tests.

fields.sentence: Hesper reports essence production to the Council at each full moon.

q1_issues.issue: (Every sk_report_1 1 month) asserts a calendar-monthly period the text never supplies - "at each full moon" states no period or rate, and the instruction set both restricts the named-slot cycle mapping to calendar slot words (weekday to week, day-part to day, month name to year) and says Every/TimesPer need a stated period or rate, leaving the unrepresentable adverbial out rather than mis-slotting it.

q2_gaps: a frequency adjunct whose slot is a recurring non-calendar occurrence ("at each full moon") - it is not one of the structured Time terms, not a day-part constant, and not the clausal "every time / whenever" occurrence-rule form, so neither the flat habitual slot+cycle route nor the Implication route is licensed for it
review.notes: Everything else is correct: report with an entity object keeps Agent (Experiencer is reserved for a sealed finite complement), "the Council" is a capitalized common-noun label so it takes a witness and no Name atom, essence_production gets its head genus with the noun modifier correctly not exposed, and the habitual present takes no tense atom. Recording the slot as a bare (Time sk_report_1 full_moon) symbol adds no content and is the least-committal option available.

issues.reason: No word in the sentence supplies "month" — the named-slot-implies-cycle mapping is stated only for calendar slot words (weekday to week, day-part to day, month name to year), and Quantifiers says Every/TimesPer need a stated period or rate — so (Every sk_report_1 1 month) is world knowledge added as content, and a false approximation besides (a lunar cycle is not a calendar month).

gaps_confirmed: A frequency adjunct whose recurring slot is a non-calendar named occurrence ("at each full moon"): it is not a structured Time term, not a day-part constant, and not a clause, so neither the flat slot+cycle route nor the "every time / whenever" occurrence-rule route can carry its recurrence.
new_gaps: A named-time constant that is itself a COMPOUND (full_moon) has no stated decomposition doctrine: Compound concepts would mandate a head genus (and, for a gradable predicable modifier, a modifier genus) for a kind symbol, while Time says a named/deictic time is a bare symbol that never takes a Member atom — so it is undecided whether such a constant owes any Inheritance atoms at all.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form is to drop (Every sk_report_1 1 month) and keep (Time sk_report_1 full_moon) alone with the unmarked (habitual-default) event; for the "each" recurrence itself the instruction set licenses NO form — full_moon is outside the calendar-slot cycle table and no period or rate is stated — so it is left out and recorded as the gap above.
adjudication.notes: Everything else is correct: Agent for "report" with a nominal object (Experiencer is reserved for a sealed finite complement), "the Council" as a capitalized common-noun label with a witness and no Name atom, the essence_production head genus with the noun modifier correctly unexposed, and no tense atom on the habitual present. (Time sk_report_1 full_moon) is itself licensed, since a named time stays a bare symbol.
